doc: I show the state of a list tab here: loading, a sentence when it failed (it names the fix when the database has no dates yet), or the list.

behaviours: initials: the first letter of the first and of the last word
initials: one word gives one letter; nothing gives a question mark
dayText: the form the retirement card always used, 'Oct 31, 2026'; nothing for nothing
a birthday card: the name, the designation, the department; no extra line
a retirement card: 'Retiring: Oct 31, 2026' in red, as before
a silver jubilee card: '25 years: Oct 12, 2026'
a birthday card never shows a date, even if one is passed
a person with no photo gets the INITIALS in the same 64 x 80 box
a person with a photo gets the photo (lazy, with his name as the description)
everything typed in a record is escaped

a list shows each person ONCE at first (the repeat for the seamless loop is made only after it is measured and found taller than its box: with one or two people a repeat would show as a second identical card)
an empty list says so in words
the same card for the three lists, each with its own kind
loading: a spinner and 'Loading...'
an error is a sentence in red, announced; it names the fix when the database has no dates yet
once the data is there the list is shown, even if a later refresh failed
the four tabs, in this order: Birthdays (Today), Calendar, Retirements (month), Silver Jubilee (month)
the month shows on Retirements and on Silver Jubilee, in three letters ('Oct'), the month in India
the tabs are a real tab list; the first is chosen
the tab strip scrolls sideways (the four tabs do not fit the small panel), with no visible scrollbar, and no tab shrinks or wraps
the first tab (Birthdays) shows its sample people at once, with their pictures, and does not wait for the database
there is no 'sample' note on the widget (the data is sample data by design in this development phase; owner, 1 Nov 2026)
the 'still mounted' flag is switched ON again at every mount (StrictMode mounts, unmounts, mounts: the same bug that once greyed the PAX editor for ever)
the lists are fetched fresh at midnight India time (+ a few seconds), by a timer that arms itself again
a page left open comes back on a new day: it asks again when it becomes visible and the day has changed
the data is never cached by the browser
the widget has no names of its own: the sample people live in sampleLists.ts, which the widget imports; the old mock components are not back
Birthdays and Retirements take the sample lists, Silver Jubilee still takes the database's list (people?.jubilee)
the five sample birthdays and five sample retirements have names, designations, departments and a picture that exists in the public folder
every sample retirement is on the last day of the current month in India, and shows it on its card
the calendar tab and its holiday fetch are as they were (EventCalendar still gets its FetchedHoliday type from this file)
